name: Live Urgent Care
address: 107 Town Center Road, King of Prussia, PA, 19406
description: Live Urgent Care on Town Center Road is for the sprain, the fever, the cut, and the thing that cannot wait for a Tuesday physical.

hero.headline: Urgent care when the day goes sideways
hero.sub: Live Urgent Care on Town Center Road is for the sprain, the fever, the cut, and the thing that cannot wait for a Tuesday physical.

story.heading: A clinic for the unplanned
paragraphs: You do not plan an urgent care visit. You just need the door to be open and the staff to move.
Tell us what started, when it started, and what you have already taken. We will take it from there.
Live Urgent Care serves people who live and work in King of Prussia.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.
Neighbors already know the name. The site should make the first visit easy.

feature.heading: King of Prussia, same day
feature.text: We handle the problems that show up after work and on weekends. If you need the ER instead, we will say so.

spotlight.heading: 107 Town Center Road
spotlight.text: Easy to find in King of Prussia. Bring an ID and a short list of medications.

contact.heading: Come in today
contact.sub: Confirm hours on the official site, then head over. The address is on this page.
